candidates.source_name: Централен регистар на РСМ (CRM RSM) — official portal
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory business registry of North Macedonia (Трговски регистар, Регистар на други правни лица, Регистар на годишни сметки, Регистар на вистински сопственици). Registration is legally compulsory, so every local payments/banking vendor, integrator, PSP and every MK entity or branch of a foreign vendor must appear here. Root node for the whole cell.
candidates.access_status: public site; several data services fee-based / account-gated
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic targeted lookups by ЕМБС / company name; scheduled re-check of the registry's public service pages for new entity/branch registrations of target vendors; document fee/account requirements before any bulk approach.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language seed search + English seed search
queries_used: Централен регистар на Република Северна Македонија пребарување на субјекти
Central Registry North Macedonia company search annual accounts online

candidates.source_name: CRM — Основен профил на регистриран субјект (free basic company profile service)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the core identifying fields per entity — ЕМБС, ЕДБ, full/short name, founding date, legal form, legal status, address, primary activity (НКД), size — including inactive, bankrupt and liquidating entities. This is the cheapest reliable way to confirm that a payments vendor actually has an MK legal presence and when it was created.
candidates.access_status: described as publicly/freely accessible basic data (Open Government commitment)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Entity-by-entity lookups against a watchlist of vendor names; store ЕМБС as the join key for all other MK sources.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + direct fetch of the service page
queries_used: Централен регистар на Република Северна Македонија пребарување на субјекти

candidates.source_name: CRM — Дистрибутивен систем (Distribution System, bulk/commercial data orders)
candidates.why_relevant: The registry's paid data-distribution channel: structured extracts and lists of entities (filterable by activity code, status, size) rather than one-off lookups. This is the mechanism that would allow systematic screening of e.g. НКД 62.01/62.09/66.19/64.99 populations for vendor/competitor mapping.
candidates.access_status: account required; search results indicate a minimum prepayment (~MKD 5,000) and enabled access to the Distribution System application
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Commercial subscription decision; if taken, one-time bulk pull by activity code plus periodic delta pulls. Treat as procurement item, not scraping target.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on data distribution / API terms
queries_used: Централен регистар веб сервиси е-дистрибуција на податоци API претплата дистрибутери на податоци

candidates.source_name: CRM — Регистар на годишни сметки / поднесување годишна сметка (annual accounts register)
candidates.why_relevant: Single central electronic repository of annual accounts for MK legal entities; filing is compulsory. Gives revenue, result and headcount trajectories for local banking/payments software vendors and for MK subsidiaries of foreign vendors — the only systematic quantitative competitor signal for private companies.
candidates.access_status: filing portal public; retrieval of statements generally fee-based
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual pull (statements land ~Feb–Mar for prior year) for a fixed watchlist; either directly from CRM or via a licensed aggregator to reduce per-document cost.
queries_used: crm.com.mk дистрибуција на податоци годишни сметки регистар на годишни сметки услуги

candidates.source_name: CRM — Регистар на вистински сопственици (Beneficial Ownership Register)
candidates.why_relevant: Operational since 27 Jan 2021 under the AML/CFT law, run by CRM jointly with the Financial Intelligence Office. Reveals the natural persons behind MK-registered payments/IT companies and behind local partners of foreign vendors — key for spotting proxy entities, resellers and undisclosed group links. Searchable by ЕМБС or partial name.
candidates.access_status: restricted — reported as available through an official procedure and payment of a fee; broader public disclosure is an OGP commitment still in progress
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Case-by-case formal requests for specific entities of interest rather than bulk collection; monitor OGP commitments MK0144/MK0185 for the point at which the data becomes openly published.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + English snowball to OGP/OpenOwnership
queries_used: Регистар на вистински сопственици Централен регистар РСМ пребарување

candidates.why_relevant: Name reservation precedes incorporation. Checking whether a foreign payments brand's name has been reserved in MK is an early-warning signal of market entry, weeks before an entity or branch actually appears in the Trade Register.

negative_findings.description: No free, machine-readable bulk export of the MK Trade Register or the Register of Annual Accounts was found. Searches in Macedonian for a CRM API / e-distribution service led only to the fee-based Дистрибутивен систем (https://www.crm.com.mk/DS/orders), with search snippets indicating an account plus a minimum prepayment of roughly MKD 5,000.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bulk registry data appears to be a paid, contract-based channel; no open API endpoint was identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any plan to screen the whole population of MK payments/IT vendors by activity code must be budgeted as a data purchase, or routed through a licensed aggregator such as CompanyWall.

negative_findings.description: The Register of Beneficial Owners is reported as accessible only through an official procedure and payment of a fee; open publication is still an OGP commitment (MK0144/MK0185) targeted initially at public-procurement winners rather than all companies.
negative_findings.result_summary: Beneficial ownership data exists and is legally compulsory, but is not openly searchable by the public today.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership-graph work on MK vendors and local partners of foreign vendors must be done case-by-case and cannot be automated at this time.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated register or published list of branches/representative offices of foreign companies in North Macedonia was found as a separate searchable dataset; branches appear to be filed inside the general Trade Register through a registration agent.
negative_findings.result_summary: Foreign-vendor branch entries must be discovered by name search within the general Trade Register, not from a standalone foreign-branch list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Detecting a foreign payments vendor's market entry requires an active name watchlist rather than passive monitoring of a branch registry feed.

negative_findings.description: A Macedonian-language query for the National Bank of RNM register of payment service providers / payment institutions returned almost exclusively Bulgarian National Bank pages, because of Cyrillic term overlap between mk and bg ('Народна банка', 'регистър/регистар', 'платежни').
negative_findings.result_summary: The NBRSM payment-institution register URL was not confirmed in this run; only a Службен весник PDF of the Law on Payment Services and Payment Systems (2022) surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cross-lingual Cyrillic bleed is a systematic hazard for MK local-language searching; queries must be pinned with MK-specific tokens ('РСМ', 'Северна Македонија', site:nbrm.mk) to avoid BG contamination.

negative_findings.description: The fetched CRM service page for Основен профил did not expose a direct link to the public search application itself; the search entry point was only described, not linked, in the retrieved markdown.
negative_findings.result_summary: The exact URL of the free public entity-search app was not isolated; only the service description page was retrieved.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collection pipeline needs the concrete query endpoint; this is an open item for the verification pass, not evidence that the service is absent.

coverage_gaps.description: The concrete public search endpoint(s) of the Central Registry (free basic-profile lookup and any ЕМБС query URL) were not pinned down in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the verification pass crawl https://www.crm.com.mk/ and its mk/en services trees to capture the actual query URLs and parameter forms; record whether login is required.

coverage_gaps.description: The seed queries referenced NKD codes 6499 and 6612, but no source was found that lets one browse MK entities by activity code for free; the mapping from payments/banking-software business models to NKD Rev.2/2.1 codes (62.01, 62.09, 63.11, 64.99, 66.19, 66.12) has not been validated against MK usage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain the current НКД Рев.2.1 classification list and check which codes MK payments vendors actually register under, then use those codes as the screening filter in the CRM Distribution System or CompanyWall.

coverage_gaps.description: Registry-adjacent event sources were not covered in this run: insolvency/liquidation announcements, pledge and leasing registers, and Службен весник publication of registry-related acts — all of which reveal vendor distress, secured financing and corporate restructuring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on Службен весник (slvesnik.com.mk), the CRM pledge/leasing registers, and any bankruptcy announcement channel; classify each as direct registry source.

coverage_gaps.description: Fees, licensing terms and permitted reuse for CRM's Distribution System and for CompanyWall's Web API were not read from primary terms documents; the MKD 5,000 figure comes from a search snippet only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the CRM tariff/contract documents and the aggregator ToS before any automated collection is designed, so that collection_allowed is grounded in the actual licence.

coverage_gaps.description: Business registries are structurally poor for the 'case studies' topic — they record existence and finances, not deployments or references. This cell produced almost nothing on that topic.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Rely on other cells (vendor sites, procurement, press) for case studies; use this cell only to corroborate the legal entities named in them.

brief: North Macedonia's corporate-filing landscape is highly centralised: the Централен регистар на РСМ (crm.com.mk) operates the Trade Register, the Register of Other Legal Entities, the Register of Annual Accounts and the Register of Beneficial Owners in one institution, so essentially every payments/banking vendor with an MK presence — including branches (подружници) of foreign companies, which must file through a registration agent and publish annual accounts — is captured there. Basic entity data (ЕМБС, legal form, status, activity, address) is positioned as free and public under Open Government commitments, but the operationally valuable layers are gated: annual accounts and related-entity confirmations are fee-based, bulk extraction runs through the paid Дистрибутивен систем, and beneficial ownership is available only via formal fee-bearing procedure pending an OGP commitment to open it. The practical collection design is therefore a name/ЕМБС watchlist against CRM's free profile service, backed by a licensed aggregator (CompanyWall) for financial statements at scale, with the State Statistical Office's active-business-entity series by НКД as the population denominator and MSE issuer filings, МАСИТ's member directory and OpenCorporates as pointer layers that convert soft actor names into hard registry records. Main open risks: the exact free-search endpoint, the correct NKD codes for this sector, and unread licensing terms.
